# Non-sensitive hygiene patterns — safe to commit. Extended-regex (ERE) syntax;
# the scan runs `git grep -iE`, so case-insensitivity comes from the -i flag
# (do NOT use inline (?i) — that's PCRE and errors under ERE).
#
# Customer-specific / engagement patterns are injected at scan time from the
# CUSTOMER_DENYLIST Actions secret and are NEVER committed here: this file ships
# to anyone who can read the repo, so a customer name in it would be the very
# disclosure the scan exists to prevent.

# Lab network identifiers are injected at scan time from the LAB_ADDRESSES
# Actions secret (comma-separated), never committed here.
